Method.name: Transform
Method.Description: Transform from Ens AlertRequest to an JSON APE message
Method.Implementation:
#Dim tResultSet As %SQL.StatementResult #Dim tAPEInfo As IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.ApeInformation
Set tStatus = $$$OK Try { Set pTarget = ##class(EnsLib.HTTP.GenericMessage).%New()
#; Create the APE Info object Set tStatus = ..CreateAPEInfo(pSource,.tAPEInfo) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tStatus = ..GetInputData(pSource,.tAPEInfo) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tStatus = ..CreateJSONStream(tAPEInfo,.tJSONStream) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tStatus = pTarget.HTTPHeaders.SetAt("application/json","content-type") $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tStatus = pTarget.HTTPHeaders.SetAt(tJSONStream.Size,"content-length") $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set pTarget.Stream = tJSONStream
} Catch eException { Set tStatus = eException.AsStatus() } Quit tStatus
